 Hon'Ble Sameer Jain, J.
1 .  Sri Manoj Kumar Pandey, learned counsel for applicants and Sri Rajeev Dhar Dwivedi, learned AGA for the State are present.

2. The instant transfer application has been filed by the applicant with a prayer to transfer the Criminal Case No.1058 of 2005 arising out of Case Crime No. 1391 of 2003, under Sections 498A,
323, 504, 506 IPC, Police Station Kotwali Orai, District Jalaun at Orai pending in the court of Civi Judge (J.D.) F.T.C. (Offence against Women) Jalaun at Orai to District Jhansi.

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel for applicant submits, applicant does not want to press the instant transfer application, therefore, same may be dismissed as withdrawn.
4. Learned AGA is having no objection.
5. In view of above, the instant transfer application stands dismissed as withdrawn.
